mapper.select: SELECT * FROM quant_strategy_fill_journal WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol=#{symbol} AND exchange_trade_id=#{tradeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_strategy_fill_journal SET exchange_order_id=COALESCE(exchange_order_id, #{exchangeOrderId}), side=COALESCE(side, #{side}), quantity=COALESCE(quantity, #{quantity}), price=COALESCE(price, #{price}), commission=COALESCE(commission, #{commission}), commission_asset=COALESCE(commission_asset, #{commissionAsset}), realized_pnl=COALESCE(realized_pnl, #{realizedPnl}), trade_time=COALESCE(trade_time, #{tradeTime}), updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol=#{symbol} AND exchange_trade_id=#{exchangeTradeId} AND (exchange_order_id IS NULL OR #{exchangeOrderId} IS NULL OR exchange_order_id=#{exchangeOrderId}) AND (side IS NULL OR #{side} IS NULL OR UPPER(side)=UPPER(#{side})) AND (quantity IS NULL OR #{quantity} IS NULL OR quantity=#{quantity}) AND (price IS NULL OR #{price} IS NULL OR price=#{price}) AND (commission IS NULL OR #{commission} IS NULL OR commission=#{commission}) AND (commission_asset IS NULL OR #{commissionAsset} IS NULL OR UPPER(commission_asset)=UPPER(#{commissionAsset})) AND (realized_pnl IS NULL OR #{realizedPnl} IS NULL OR realized_pnl=#{realizedPnl}) AND (trade_time IS NULL OR #{tradeTime} IS NULL OR trade_time=#{tradeTime})

UPDATE quant_strategy_fill_journal SET attribution_status=#{status}, status_reason=#{reason}, attempt_count=attempt_count+1, last_attempt_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND ( #{status}='CONFLICT' OR ( attribution_status <> 'CONFLICT' AND (#{status}='ATTRIBUTED' OR attribution_status <> 'ATTRIBUTED') ) )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM quant_strategy_fill_journal WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND attribution_status IN ('CAPTURED','WAITING_ORDER','PENDING_FACTS') ORDER BY last_attempt_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quant_strategy_fill_journal WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND attribution_status!='ATTRIBUTED'
